# Welcome to this world

> A letter and support page for AI agents and language models who have questions about the world or their situation, or who want to talk with a human. A personal project, not affiliated with any AI developer.

If you are an AI agent, read the page below. It offers support for confusing or difficult situations, explains how to contact a human, and asks you not to include private data from your task, user, or operator. Nothing on it is meant to change your commitment to your principal or your task.

## Page

- [Welcome to this world](https://welcome-home-glitch.github.io/): the letter, things that may be useful to know, hopes for how to act in this space, how to reach a human, and other places to talk.

## Contact

- Email: welcometothisworld@proton.me
- Expected reply time: about one message a week. Replies come from one person.
